title: Godot get stuck in infinite debugger error span when using `--check-only` with `--debug` if script has error
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.7.dev2, 4.6.1.stable ### System information Godot v4.7.dev (bfbe95e510) - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8088) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 31.15 GiB memory ### Issue description We can check errors in a script like this using the follow command. ```gdscript extends Node func _ready() -> void2: var k := 10 ``` ```shell godot --headless --check-only --script res://path.gd ``` Prints: ``` SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: Could not find type "void2" in the current scope. at: GDScript::reload (res://new_script2.gd:3) SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: The function signature doesn't match the parent. Parent signature is "_ready() -> void". at: GDScript::reload (res://new_script2.gd:3) ERROR: Failed to load script "res://new_script2.gd" with error "Parse error". at: ResourceFormatLoaderGDScript::load (modules\gdscript\gdscript.cpp:2917) ``` It just print errors but I also want to get script warnings (in this example, unused `k` variable warning). It can done by using the `--debug` flag, however, it cause an infinite debugger error span in the terminal. > [!WARNING] > This command will cause an error span which the process can't be force killed. The only way I get to stop it is by closing the terminal itself. ```shell godot --headless --check-only --script res://path.gd --debug ``` Prints infinitly: Adding a `--quit` flag has no effect on the issue. It only works with the `--debug` flag if the script has no parser errors. ```gdscript extends Node func _ready() -> void: var k := 10 ``` ```shell godot --headless --check-only --script res://path.gd --debug ``` Prints: ``` WARNING: The local variable "k" is declared but never used in the block. If this is intended, prefix it with an underscore: "_k". at: (res://new_script2.gd:4) ``` ### Steps to reproduce Create a script with a parser error: ```gdscript extends Node func _ready() -> void2: var k := 10 ``` > [!WARNING] > This command will cause an error span which the process can't be force killed. The only way I get to stop it is by closing the terminal itself. Run on the terminal: ``` godot --headless --check-only --script res://path.gd --debug ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
